commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Whatever is said, by whoever says it, understanding can see its true worth. All people shift between the three qualities, so high things may come from low mouths, low things from the high, good counsel from enemies and ruin from friends. So take or leave a thing by its worth, not by the nature of the speaker.
